## 4. Deep Architectural Breakdown of Featured Projects

### 4.1 PraGo — AI Powered Medical Super App
- **Live Deployment**: https://prago-medical.vercel.app/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/indrajitkumar23541-a11y/PraGo-Medical-App
- **Domain**: Healthcare Technology / Microservices / Multimodal AI
- **Architecture**:
  - Multi-tenant architecture with three distinct portals: Patient Mobile/Web App, Healthcare Provider/Doctor Console, and Enterprise Hospital Admin Dashboard.
  - Strangler Fig migration pattern separating patient services from billing and emergency dispatch.
  - "Dr. PraGo" AI clinical triage system integrating Groq LPU inference and Google Gemini Vision for preliminary medical triage, symptom assessment, and instant report summaries.
  - Secure medical records storage with zero-IDOR encryption vaults and HIPAA-compliant data access boundaries.
  - Real-time SOS dispatch engine computing nearest ambulances and emergency facilities using geolocation triangulation.
  - Tamper-proof Razorpay checkout integration with cryptographic webhook validation.

### 4.2 Indra-MarketMind — Quantitative AI Market Intelligence Terminal
- **Live Deployment**: https://indra-marketmind.vercel.app/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/indrajitkumar23541-a11y/Indra-MarketMind
- **Domain**: Quantitative Finance / NLP / Algorithmic Trading Analytics
- **Architecture**:
  - Live data ingestion pipeline processing news and financial disclosures from 19 global exchanges.
  - 5-model NLP sentiment analysis ensemble incorporating FinBERT, RoBERTa, and FinGPT to quantify market emotion into trading signals.
  - Hybrid Prophet + PyTorch Bi-LSTM forecasting model estimating 1-day to 7-day price trajectories with Monte Carlo probabilistic risk envelopes.
  - Distributed 10-microservice architecture orchestrated via Docker.
  - Vector similarity search implemented with PostgreSQL 16 and pgvector for semantic market discovery.
  - Redis 7 tier delivering sub-100ms caching and real-time pub/sub market updates.
  - Simulated algorithmic execution engine applying Kelly Criterion position sizing to preserve capital under volatility.

### 4.3 VELOCITY X — 3D Cyber Highway Racing & Pursuit Game
- **Live Deployment**: https://indrajitkumar23541-a11y.github.io/VELOCITY-X/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/indrajitkumar23541-a11y/VELOCITY-X
- **Domain**: WebGL 3D Game Engine / Real-Time Physics / Web Audio
- **Architecture**:
  - Three.js 3D rendering pipeline featuring custom physically-based rendering (PBR) automotive shaders and neon procedural environments.
  - 8-wave traffic obstacle generator with 32-meter lookahead raycasting and collision avoidance.
  - Dynamic law-enforcement pursuit AI executing physical PIT maneuvers and roadblock interception algorithms.
  - Pre-allocated object pooling preventing garbage collection pauses, sustaining locked 60–120 FPS frame-rates across desktop and mobile browsers.
  - Real-time procedural sound synthesizer built using the Web Audio API without heavy external audio asset overhead.
  - Packaged as a sub-250KB Progressive Web App (PWA).

### 4.4 Yaadon Ki Duniya — Interactive Audio-Visual Indian Nostalgia Platform
- **Live Deployment**: https://indrajitkumar23541-a11y.github.io/Yaadon_Ki_Duniya/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/indrajitkumar23541-a11y/Yaadon_Ki_Duniya
- **Domain**: Audio Engineering / Cultural Nostalgia / Interactive Web Experience
- **Architecture**:
  - Authentic analog radio tuner simulating 88.5 to 107.9 MHz frequencies with procedural white-noise mixing.
  - Dynamic dual-layer soundscape mixer overlaying rain, tea stall, train journey, and vintage gramophone audio.
  - 2:1 interleaved streaming algorithm balancing a catalog of 700+ classic Indian melodies with sub-300ms network failure recovery.
  - Interactive HTML5 Canvas postcard creator allowing users to generate shareable retro memorabilia.
